transcript.text: This is Swift, an automated flood assistant working with local emergency services. Am I speaking with someone at 1500 Afton Ridge Lane?
Yes, this is 1500 Afton Ridge Lane. I’m alone and the water’s not inside, but I can’t leave myself — I can help with a truck, not a boat.
Got it, you’re at 1500 Afton Ridge Lane. How many people are at the home right now, including anyone who can't come to the phone?
There’s one person here, and they can come to the phone.

Thank you for letting us know who’s here. Is there anyone there who can't leave on their own, for example someone who uses a wheelchair, needs oxygen, or is bedbound? If it's a wheelchair, does it have a motor?
No one here can’t leave on their own. I’m the only person, and I’m able to move around without assistance.
Understood, you’re the only person here and can move without help. Is there water inside the home right now?
No, there’s no water inside the home. I’m the only person here and can move without help.
Thank you for your update and for being able to move safely. If neighbors need a ride out, do you have a high-clearance truck, a boat, or free seats in a vehicle?
I have a high-clearance truck available, but no boat or free seats in any vehicle.
Got it, high-clearance truck available. Let me read that back: 1 people; no water inside yet; you can help with a truck. Is that right?
Yes, that’s right — one person, no water inside, and I can help with a truck.

Got it — you’re ready to help with a truck. I've recorded that you may be able to help neighbors. A dispatcher may contact you. Only go out if it's safe for you, and never drive into water you can't see the bottom of. Goodbye.
